body.statement: In \(\text{def:affine-witness}\), the observed recursion \(Y_{i,t+1}=\overline U_t+H_{it}^{G,N}+\epsilon_{it}\), \(U_{it}=Y_{it}/2+W_{i,t+1}\), gives the checked table \[\begin{array}{c|c|c|c|c}t&\mathbb E[Y_t]&\mathbb E[Y_t^2]&\mathbb E[U_t]&q_t=\mathbb E[U_t^2]\\\hline 0&0&1&1/4&1/4+p_0=1/2\\1&1/4&25/16&7/8&25/64+p_1(1/4)+p_1=85/64\\2&7/8&99/32&11/16&99/128+p_2(7/8)+p_2=159/128\end{array}\] using \(\mathbb E[(Y_t/2+W_{t+1})^2]=\mathbb E[Y_t^2]/4+p_t\mathbb E[Y_t]+p_t\), including the Bernoulli cross term \(\mathbb E[Y_tW_{t+1}]=p_t\mathbb E[Y_t]\). The relevant Gram entry and variance-design determinant are \[K_{01}=\tfrac12\mathbb E[U_0Y_1]+p_1\mathbb E[U_0]=1/32+3/16=7/32,\qquad \det(X_v^{\top}X_v)=3\sum_{t=0}^2q_t^2-\left(\sum_{t=0}^2q_t\right)^2=10191/8192.\] Furthermore, \(\Delta_{1,N}^{Y}=\sqrt N(\overline U_0-1/4)+A_{0,N}^{G}+\sqrt N\,\overline\epsilon_0\) has limiting variance \(7/16+1/2+1=31/16\), while \(\Delta_{2,N}^{Y}=\tfrac12\Delta_{1,N}^{Y}+\sqrt N(\overline W_2-3/4)+A_{1,N}^{G}+\sqrt N\,\overline\epsilon_1\). The sole same-matrix-reuse contribution is \(\lim_N\operatorname{Cov}(\Delta_{1,N}^{Y},A_{1,N}^{G})=K_{01}=7/32\), so \(\lim_N\operatorname{Cov}(\Delta_{1,N}^{Y},\Delta_{2,N}^{Y})=(1/2)(31/16)+7/32=19/16\). The residual blocks are \(C\), \(2(C\circ C)\), and zero mixed covariance. For the counterfactual recursion, \(\mu_0^{(a)}=a\), \(\kappa_0^{(a)}=1/4+a^2\), \((m_1^{(a)},m_2^{(a)},m_3^{(a)})=(a,3a/2,7a/4)\), and \(\theta_3=(1,3/2,7/4)\).
body.justification: This recomputed special case verifies both the energy arithmetic and the corrected first-step use of the full initial law.
body.gap: Published Causal-MP examples do not report this reuse covariance, determinant, or counterfactual-path reduction.
body.consumer: The identities form a deterministic regression test for the covariance and path implementations.
